display.purpose: The dealt card's rank and suit only.

label.purpose: Uppercase stat labels and call-button odds percentages.

motion.name: tap-scale
motion.purpose: Tactile confirmation on every button, no hover state.

motion.name: streak-glow
motion.value: text-shadow, two stacked layers scaling with min(streak,10)/10
motion.purpose: Momentum feedback on the streak number.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bank / Share / Redeem lifeline — the one accent-filled CTA per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2DD4BF; color: #0B0E14; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary path out of a decision (start new game, decline lifeline).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #E7EAF0; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid #2E3646; border-radius: 8px; transition: transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Call Button
components.description: Fixed-identity outcome-agnostic call button (Lower/Same/Higher/Red/Black each get their own solid fill).
components.css: .ds-btn-call { background: #A855F7; color: #0B0E14; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 8px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; transition: transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-call:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-call-odds { font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Playing Card
components.css: .ds-card { width: 176px; height: 256px; background: #E7EAF0; border: 2px solid #1E2430; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-card-rank { font-size: 60px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #B8464C; } .ds-card-suit { font-size: 36px; line-height: 1; margin-top: 8px; color: #B8464C; }

components.name: Deck Chip
components.description: Deck switcher / tab nav selection chip.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { background: rgba(45,212,191,0.12); color: #2DD4BF; border: 2px solid #2DD4BF; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; } .ds-chip-meta { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: 0.85; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Username Input
components.description: Text field with inline validation caption.
components.html: 2–16 letters only (a-z) — no numbers or symbols.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-input { background: #0B0E14; color: #E7EAF0; border: 1px solid #1E2430; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-field-hint { font-size: 12px; color: #7A8496; }

components.name: Status Panel
components.description: The matched border/soft-background/text trio used for every informational surface (rules sections, status strip, banners).
components.css: .ds-panel-win { border: 1px solid #22C55E; background: rgba(34,197,94,0.12); color: #22C55E; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview:
Hi-Lo Same reads as a dense, flat, dark console built for someone executing a fast decision under real stakes — not a game skin, not a casino face. Numbers move like live prices: every value that can change (streak, vault, timer, ante, odds) renders in tabular numerals so nothing jitters as digits shift. Uppercase micro-labels sit above the numbers they describe, exactly like a terminal's status strip.

The mood is tense, alert, high-stakes. A six-second countdown bar shifts from Signal Teal through Warning Amber to Ticker Red as time runs out; the streak number's glow intensifies with each consecutive win (capped at streak 10); a bust triggers an instant full-screen red flash plus a screen-shake, a win an instant green flash — feedback lands in under 200ms. Every control confirms a tap by scaling to 95%, the system's one interactive motion beyond color and opacity.

This is a confirmed rejection, not a gap: an earlier "Poker Table" theme (felt-gradient background, wooden-frame chrome) was removed outright. No gradients, no felt, no wood grain, no drop shadows exist anywhere in the current system.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black flat surfaces, one signal-teal accent used sparingly
Tabular numerals on every value that can change
Solid-fill, fixed-identity color coding (outcomes vs. call buttons vs. status)
Tactile tap-down confirmation (active:scale-95) on every control, no hover-only affordances
Zero gradients, zero shadows, by explicit design history

rules.name: The Outcome-Only Rule
rules.body: Ticker Green and Ticker Red mean this hand is resolved — never a preview or prediction. A call button's color is fixed identity, not a hint about whether it will win.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Teal is the only color that means alive/actionable. Everything else is inert neutral, a fixed outcome color, or a fixed identity color.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change in place renders with tabular numerals so surrounding layout never shifts as digits change width.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no gradient, anywhere, under any circumstance. State and hierarchy are communicated with color, border weight, and flat layering only.

dos: Do keep Signal Teal to the "one live thing" role — CTA, selection, and positive momentum only.
Do pair every state color as a matched border + soft-background + text trio in the same hue.
Do render every number that can change with tabular numerals.
Do keep every button's radius at 8px and its tap feedback at active:scale-95.
Do reserve Ticker Green and Ticker Red for confirmed outcomes only.
donts: Don't add box-shadow or a gradient anywhere.
Don't introduce a second accent color alongside Signal Teal.
Don't color a call button to hint at whether it's likely to win.
Don't rely on a hover-only affordance as the sole way to discover a control.
Don't render a heart or diamond suit in Ticker Red.
